## 3 Core Service Pillars
1. **High-Converting Web & Full-Stack Product Engineering:** Custom E-Commerce Storefronts (1-Click WhatsApp/Checkout Funnels), SaaS Web Apps, and Scalable Backends using Python, Django, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS.
2. **Technical SEO & Sub-Second Speed Optimization:** Semantic HTML architecture, Core Web Vitals optimization (100/100 PageSpeed, < 0.8s LCP), JSON-LD Schema markup, programmatic SEO, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
3. **Custom AI Agents & Business Workflow Automation:** RAG-trained Knowledge Base Agents, 24/7 Automated Customer Support (Web, WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord), and B2B Lead Generation workflows.

## Key Case Studies & Portfolio
- **ShopFast Headless E-Commerce:** 100/100 Speed Score, sub-second static storefront, client-side cart & Stripe/COD checkout.
- **Edel Bangladesh & Fuler Dokan (1-Click F-Commerce Engines):** Automated ordering storefronts replacing manual Messenger orders with dynamic size/variant calculators and 1-click WhatsApp order receipts.
- **Vanguard B2B Analytics SaaS:** High-performance dark-mode data dashboard built with React, D3.js, and Python/Django API architecture.
- **Aura Commerce:** Mobile-first high-converting DTC brand funnel.
- **Autonomous RAG Support Guardian:** Custom LLM + RAG agent handling 7,000+ community members and reducing manual support tickets by 80%.
- **SolNova & AutoGit Deployer:** Client-side DevOps engine & Web3 dashboard demonstrating complex state and API mastery.
